entities.name: EAP-response/AKA'-authentication-reject message

entities.name: EAP-response/AKA'-synchronization-failure message
entities.description: EAP response sent when sequence number in AUTN is not correct

entities.name: EAP-response/AKA'-client-error message
entities.description: EAP response sent for other errors or when USIM is not present

entities.name: SNN check fails
entities.description: Condition where Serving Network Name check fails during EAP-request/AKA'-challenge handling

entities.name: AUTN not accepted
entities.description: Condition where UE does not accept AUTN during EAP-request/AKA'-challenge handling

entities.name: Sequence number in AUTN not correct
entities.description: Condition where UE detects incorrect sequence number in AUTN during EAP-request/AKA'-challenge handling

entities.name: Other error detected
entities.description: Condition where UE detects another error during EAP-request/AKA'-challenge handling

entities.name: USIM not present
entities.description: Condition where USIM is not present in the UE

entities.name: Timer T3520
entities.description: Timer started when AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE message containing EAP-response is sent

entities.name: Timer T3510
entities.description: Timer that may be running and needs to be stopped when sending authentication response

entities.name: Timer T3517
entities.description: Timer that may be running and needs to be stopped when sending authentication response

entities.name: Timer T3521
entities.description: Timer that may be running and needs to be stopped when sending authentication response

relations.description: SNN check failure condition leads to sending authentication reject message
AUTN not accepted condition leads to sending authentication reject message
Incorrect sequence number condition leads to sending synchronization failure message
Other error detection condition leads to sending client error message
USIM not present condition leads to sending client error message
Sending authentication reject message starts timer T3520
Sending synchronization failure message starts timer T3520
Sending client error message starts timer T3520
Sending authentication reject message stops timer T3510 if running
Sending authentication reject message stops timer T3517 if running
Sending authentication reject message stops timer T3521 if running
Receiving EAP-request/AKA'-challenge message stops timer T3520 if running
